note: LOBT prediction bound. Project every prediction onto [mvt_minus_lobt - 3606, mvt_minus_lobt + 3606], lower edge raised to 0. y = MVT - BLOCK and |BLOCK - LOBT| <= 3606 is an identity on this data, so the truth lies inside that window and clipping onto it is a metric projection: |clip(p) - y| <= |p - y| row by row. Built by transforming the scored v10 file directly, no retrain, 34 rows differ and 344,807 are bit-identical. PRE-REGISTERED PRICE: guaranteed >= +0.121 s, expected +0.36 s, absolute worst case -0.355 s. A result outside [-0.36, +0.90] falsifies the construction, not the rule. Known weakness: one LFPG flight carries 77.7% of the guaranteed gain, so the realised delta is close to a two-point distribution. The bound cannot be verified on 2026 because BLOCK is blanked. See docs/competitor_research_2026-09-21/plans/P5-physics-lower-bound.md and P5-REVIEW.md.

Dead-column removal. Drops five model-visible constants: precip_mm (0.00 on 100 % of 138,446 cached station-hours - the IEM feed never populated it), precip_mm_prev1h, temp_x_precip and temp_x_precip_prev1h (products with it, zero by construction), and runway_null. Found by the new coverage gate (src/prc/coverage.py, P8-D). Measured as a removal against a removal control: pooled over [forward, jul_fwd], 518,722 rows, base -> drop -0.13 [-0.25, -0.02], K=200 -0.14 [-0.28, -0.01], month bootstrap -0.13 [-0.17, -0.12] P=1.000, ADOPT on both gates; dropping five LIVE columns instead costs +0.22 s and visibly moves both models, so the instrument is not blind to a five-column removal. Model B is bit-identical between base and drop (0 of 6,943 unmatched rows differ), so the change acts on model A alone. Honest caveat: the four-fold CV here is 277.53 against v14's 277.54, i.e. -0.01, not -0.13. The arms were two folds with es_holdout_encodings on; this build has it off, because with it on the refit OOM-killed five times at 13.96 GB against a 13,681 MB cgroup limit. Expect at most -0.1 s. C1 (proxy_is_nominal, -0.29 [-0.55, -0.07] on forward) is NOT in this build - it does not fit in memory and is being re-measured without proxy_sec_in_min.

ADS-B pushback override on v14. Base outputs/main_gap.parquet (v14, board 279.5234). For scored departures at EDDM, EHAM, LEBL, LSZH and EGLL where open ADS-B (adsb.lol globe_history, ODbL 1.0, documented in docs/external_data.md) shows the aircraft pushing back from the stand, the prediction is replaced by MVT - pushback + a per-airport bias, unless it disagrees with the base by more than 900 s (the guard). All 62 scored days ingested. 63,532 rows changed (18.42 %). Validated out of sample with rules, bias and guard frozen: +16,362 s^2 per covered row [14,075, 18,732] on three new labelled days; coverage 17.6 % Jan / 22.3 % Jul. EGLL included on a pre-written leave-one-day-out rule (+21,718 [12,989, 31,852]). Board estimate at dBoard/dOOF 0.747: central -3.9 to -5.2 s, range -0.8 to -11. The OOF-to-board carry-over is untested - this upload is the test. One override produced -46 s (a certain detection failure) and was reverted to v14's 708 s, matching the pipeline's own non-negativity. Built on v14, not v16 (279.259, parallel session), whose file is not in this checkout.
